solutions.check: bars rebuilt from the blog's numbered answers (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Joy unbounded: Irons playing a duke

indicators.note: a word with its bounds taken away loses its first and last letters, leaving only the core
letters that are playing are at play, free to move about into a new order

blocks.note: the middle letter of joy, once its outer letters are stripped
taken as written, to be rearranged

explanation.surface: The actor Jeremy Irons takes delight in being cast as a nobleman.
explanation.walkthrough: Irons reads as the actor Jeremy Irons playing a role, and the role is indeed a duke.
explanation.definitionFit: Orsino is the lovesick Duke of Illyria in Shakespeare's Twelfth Night.

clue.text: Ring up about special piece

indicators.note: turned about means facing the other way, so the word runs backwards

blocks.note: a ring is O-shaped
taken as written
S is the abbreviation for special

explanation.surface: Someone telephones about a remarkable work.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Ring up' looks like a phone call, but ring gives a letter and up is the word to turn around.
explanation.definitionFit: An opus is a musical or literary work, a piece in the artistic sense.

clue.text: Unwanted material moved eastward

indicators.note: letters that are moved are shifted into a new arrangement

blocks.note: taken as written, to be rearranged

explanation.surface: Junk was shifted towards the east.
explanation.definitionFit: Radwaste is radioactive waste, the discarded material left by nuclear processes.

clue.text: Independent pro behind news agency

blocks.note: I is the abbreviation for independent
a pro is a prostitute, slang tart
ass is slang for the behind, the buttocks

explanation.surface: A freelance professional follows a press bureau.
explanation.walkthrough: Behind looks like a position word for ordering pieces, but it is a noun meaning bottom.
explanation.definitionFit: ITAR-TASS was the name of Russia's state news agency from 1992 until 2014.

clue.text: Charlie cycling in China

indicators.note: cycling letters go round, the back end coming to the front

blocks.note: a charlie and a poop (short for nincompoop) are both fools

explanation.surface: Someone named Charlie is riding a bike in China.
explanation.walkthrough: The last two letters move to the front. China is rhyming slang: china plate = mate.
explanation.definitionFit: Oppo is British slang for a colleague or friend, which is what china, from china plate, means.

clue.text: Customs of Putin's enemy wasting time

indicators.note: wasting something means losing it, so one element drops out of the phrase

blocks.note: the Kremlin's adversary, the Western nations
T is the standard abbreviation for time

explanation.surface: A remark on the habits of Russia's opponents, who squander time.
explanation.walkthrough: The final T of the West is removed. THEWES is a Spenserian plural meaning manners, found in Chambers.
explanation.definitionFit: Thewes is an archaic word for manners or habitual ways of behaving, which are customs.

clue.text: Jumps on ice ruffled loose top

indicators.note: ruffled means disordered, so the letters are messed up

blocks.note: taken as written, to be rearranged

explanation.surface: A skater's loose blouse flutters as they leap on the rink.
explanation.definitionFit: Toe loops are figure-skating jumps launched with a tap of the toe pick.

clue.text: Exhausted soldiers wanting Sergeant-Major as promised earlier

indicators.note: wanting means lacking, so those letters are absent

blocks.note: shot means worn out
soldiers as the men in the ranks
SM is the abbreviation for Sergeant-Major

explanation.surface: Tired troops miss their senior NCO, as they were told they would.
explanation.walkthrough: The S goes from the first word and the M from the second.
explanation.definitionFit: Hoten is an obsolete past participle of hight, meaning called or promised.

clue.text: Journey once over sides of lake and rock for gastropod mollusc

indicators.note: the sides of a word are its two edges, the first and last letters

blocks.note: went is an archaic noun for a path or journey
the outer letters of lake
trap is a dark igneous rock such as basalt

explanation.surface: An old voyage across a lake's shores and rocks to find a sea snail.
explanation.walkthrough: Over places the first piece above the rest in this down entry.
explanation.definitionFit: A wentletrap is a sea snail with a tall spiral shell, a gastropod mollusc.

clue.text: Multinational's account first to show records from years ago

indicators.note: the first to a word is its opening letter

blocks.note: Shell is a multinational oil company
AC is the abbreviation for account
the opening letter of show

explanation.surface: A big company's report shows first records from years back.
explanation.walkthrough: The 's of the company is possessive; it joins it to account and gives no letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Old 78 rpm gramophone discs were pressed from shellac, so shellacs are vintage records.

clue.text: Individual spent leaving minimum of debt? Micawber's conclusion: misery

indicators.note: something leaving a word goes out of it, so that letter is taken away
the minimum of a word is its smallest part, its opening letter
a conclusion is the end, so only the final letter of the name is wanted

blocks.note: a party is a person, as in 'the guilty party'
pooped is slang for exhausted
the opening letter of debt, which leaves the previous word
the final letter of the name

explanation.surface: Dickens's Mr Micawber held that spending beyond your income ends in misery.
explanation.walkthrough: Micawber in David Copperfield said income twenty pounds, expenditure twenty pounds and sixpence, 'result misery'. Here misery is a noun for a gloomy person.
explanation.definitionFit: A misery is a killjoy who spoils others' fun, which is exactly what a party pooper is.

clue.text: Fruit container missing? Will end in charge

indicators.note: the end in a word is its last letter

blocks.note: a jar is a container
missing and gone both mean absent
'll is the shortened form of will
the final letter of charge

explanation.surface: A fruit jar has gone, and Will is to be in charge after all.
explanation.walkthrough: Will looks like a name but stands for the contraction 'll.
explanation.definitionFit: A jargonelle is an early-ripening variety of pear, a kind of fruit.

clue.text: Badly missing a positive show when Roger's away

definitions.note: a verb phrase standing for a noun meaning craving

indicators.note: when someone is away they are absent, so that letter is left out

blocks.note: taken as written
P is the abbreviation for positive
a show or false display
Roger is R in the radio alphabet once used

explanation.surface: Someone feels the lack of an upbeat display now that Roger has left.
explanation.walkthrough: The R of pretence goes. 'Badly missing' must be read as a state of longing, not as an adverb and participle.
explanation.definitionFit: Appetence is strong desire or craving, the condition of wanting something very much.

clue.text: Black and white principally for married dandy

indicators.note: principally means first of all, so only the leading letter counts
one letter put in for another takes its place

blocks.note: the leading letter of white
M is the abbreviation for married
dandy and smart both mean fine or stylish

explanation.surface: A fashionable man's outfit is chiefly monochrome.
explanation.walkthrough: In SMART the married M is replaced by W from white.
explanation.definitionFit: Swart is an old and dialect word for dark or swarthy, so black in colour.

clue.text: Annual loaned with difficulty but only one left

indicators.note: only one of a doubled letter is to remain, so its twin is dropped

blocks.note: past tense of lend
with ill, meaning with difficulty, as in 'could ill afford'

explanation.surface: A yearly payment was lent reluctantly, and just one person is left.
explanation.walkthrough: L is the abbreviation for left, so 'only one left' means keep a single L.
explanation.definitionFit: The lentil is an annual plant of the pea family, grown for its seeds.

clue.text: Neat hair Melanie cut back

indicators.note: to cut a name out of something removes it
going back means reading the remains from right to left

blocks.note: strammel is a Chambers word for straw, hence hair
Mel is the short form of Melanie

explanation.surface: A hairdresser trims Melanie's tidy hair.
explanation.walkthrough: Neat looks like an adjective for tidy hair, but it is the old noun for cattle. A mart is a cow fattened for slaughter.
explanation.definitionFit: Neat is an archaic collective for oxen; marts are cattle killed and salted for winter, so the plural fits.

clue.text: Decayed woody stuff sounds like what should prolong a fire

indicators.note: sounds like says the answer is heard rather than spelt like the phrase

blocks.note: putting on extra wood keeps a fire going

explanation.surface: Rotten timber is mentioned in the context of keeping a fire burning.
explanation.definitionFit: Moorlog is decayed wood found buried under marshes or the sea bed, partly turned to peat.

clue.text: Fabulous bird in African country trained

indicators.note: one thing in another sits inside it

blocks.note: Benin is a country in West Africa
rok is a variant spelling of roc, the giant bird of legend

explanation.surface: A mythical bird is taught tricks somewhere in Africa.
explanation.definitionFit: Broken in describes a horse or a person tamed and accustomed to work, so trained.

clue.text: Mavis arranged short let

indicators.note: arranged means put into a particular order, a new one here

blocks.note: taken as written, to be rearranged

explanation.surface: A woman called Mavis has organised a brief rental.
explanation.walkthrough: Mavis looks like a woman's name but is an old word for a song thrush.
explanation.definitionFit: Throstle and mavis are both poetic or dialect names for the song thrush.

clue.text: Warn about choice of food keeping only half a day

indicators.note: keeping something means holding it, so it sits inside
only half of the word survives, the rest being cut away

blocks.note: a is an abbreviation for about
a dish is a food item chosen from a menu
Monday, a day of the week, of which the first half is kept

explanation.surface: Someone cautions about a diet that limits meals to half the day.
explanation.walkthrough: A is a Chambers abbreviation for about.
explanation.definitionFit: To admonish is to caution or reprove someone, a stern warning.

clue.text: Heard dog barking in Irish port

indicators.note: barking is slang for mad, and mad letters are scrambled

blocks.note: taken as written, to be rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone hears a dog making a noise in an Irish harbour town.
explanation.walkthrough: Barking fits the dog so well that it hides its role as the shuffle signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Drogheda is a port town on the River Boyne in County Louth, Ireland.

clue.text: Manage after soot damaged instrument for the ear

indicators.note: damaged letters are knocked out of their order
after places the first-named word behind the following material

blocks.note: taken as written, to be rearranged
to manage is to cope

explanation.surface: Someone muddles on although soot has spoiled a hearing device.
explanation.walkthrough: 'After' puts the manage word at the end, behind the reworked soot.
explanation.definitionFit: An otoscope is the lighted instrument doctors use to look inside the ear canal.

clue.text: Three directions covering army regulation? It's a trap

indicators.note: something covering another goes around it

blocks.note: south, north and east
AR is the abbreviation for army regulation

explanation.surface: Instructions from three quarters enclosing a military rule are a trick.
explanation.definitionFit: A snare is a noose or device for catching animals, a trap.

clue.text: Eastern Muslims mostly gloomy

indicators.note: mostly means most but not all, so the last letter is lost

blocks.note: morose means sullen or gloomy

explanation.surface: A sweeping claim that believers in the East are largely sad.
explanation.definitionFit: The Moros are the Muslim peoples of the southern Philippines, in the Far East.

clue.text: Rib the monarch about succession? On the contrary

indicators.note: about means around, so one piece goes round another
this phrase flips the order just stated, so the wrapper and the wrapped swap roles

blocks.note: a line of succession, as of heirs
ER, Elizabeth Regina, the Queen

explanation.surface: Someone teases the sovereign about who will inherit the throne.
explanation.walkthrough: Read literally the monarch would go round succession; 'On the contrary' reverses that, so the line wraps the monarch.
explanation.definitionFit: A lierne is a short subsidiary rib in Gothic vaulting, joining the main ribs.

clue.text: Muscovite with perfect cleavage foremost in making innocent chap amorous

indicators.note: the foremost letters are those at the front of each word

blocks.note: the first letters of the four words

explanation.surface: A buxom Russian woman leads a naive man on.
explanation.walkthrough: Muscovite and cleavage suggest a Russian woman, but muscovite is a mineral and cleavage is how it splits.
explanation.definitionFit: Muscovite is a common mica, a mineral that splits perfectly into thin sheets.

clue.text: A short normal term in yoga

definitions.text: A short normal term in yoga

indicators.note: a word that is short is cut, losing its final letter
a term is an end point, so only the last letter of the next word is wanted

blocks.note: taken as written
sane means mentally normal
the final letter of yoga

explanation.surface: A brief standard word used in yoga practice.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue is both the wordplay and the definition: an asana is indeed a short, standard yoga term.
explanation.definitionFit: Asana is the Sanskrit word for a posture held in yoga, used everywhere yoga is taught.

clue.text: Meeting accepted its last couple, for example

blocks.note: AGM is an annual general meeting
A is the abbreviation for accepted

explanation.surface: A gathering agreed its final pair, as an illustration.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Its' refers back to the word meeting, whose last couple of letters are NG.
explanation.definitionFit: Agma is the phonetic symbol for the sound written ng, as at the close of meeting.

clue.text: Foreign relations favouring claimants to French throne

indicators.note: something foreign is strange or alien, so the letters take an unfamiliar order

blocks.note: taken as written, to be rearranged

explanation.surface: Overseas relatives back pretenders to the crown of France.
explanation.walkthrough: Foreign relations sounds like diplomacy; it is the shuffle signal plus its letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Orleanists supported the claim of the Orléans branch of the Bourbons to the French crown.

clue.text: All crime is up after Tory rule with ministers leading the way

definitions.text: rule with ministers leading the way

indicators.note: up here means in turmoil, as in 'things are up', so the letters are stirred

blocks.note: C stands for Conservative, the Tory party
taken as written, to be rearranged

explanation.surface: A grumble that crime has risen since the Conservatives took power with their ministers in charge.
explanation.walkthrough: Ministers looks political but means clergy: the definition is government led by churchmen.
explanation.definitionFit: Clericalism is a system giving the clergy power in political affairs, so priests steer the state.

clue.text: Western Samoa in retreat? Indeed that's a dream

indicators.note: retreating means going backwards, so the letters run right to left

blocks.note: WS was the international vehicle code for Western Samoa
even, as in 'even so', used for emphasis like indeed

explanation.surface: A Pacific nation pulling back sounds too good to be true.
explanation.definitionFit: Sweven is an archaic word, found in Chaucer, for a dream or vision.

clue.text: One of Mohammed's wives advanced indeed in this year

blocks.note: A is the abbreviation for advanced
yes and indeed both affirm
HA abbreviates Latin hoc anno, in this year

explanation.surface: A historical note that a wife of the Prophet moved forward this year.
explanation.definitionFit: Aisha, also spelt Ayesha, was the third wife of the Prophet Muhammad.
